# 📝 Change Proposal

## Problem
Describe the user or maintainer problem and evidence.

## Goals
List measurable outcomes.

## Non-goals
State what is out of scope.

## Proposed approach
Describe behavior, architecture, and affected files.

## Data and methodology impact
List inputs, factor sources, licensing, units, assumptions, boundaries, and review needs.

## Privacy and security impact
Describe processing, storage, integrations, secrets, and abuse risks.

## Accessibility and usability
Explain keyboard, screen reader, responsive, and content impacts.

## Testing and rollout
List tests, migration, deployment, and rollback.

## Open questions
List unresolved decisions and owners.
